about_the_game:
The 10-Year Anniversary Celebration may be over, but the party doesn’t have to stop! Show off a festive look with the 10-Year Anniversary Pack, featuring a brand-new costume and pet, plus five additional furnishings and 1000 Crowns!

This bundle includes:

• Pellitine Anniversary Drape Costume

• 10-Year Anniversary Golden Wisp Pet

• 5× Dazzler Dispenser Furnishings

• 1000 Crowns

Pellitine Anniversary Drape Costume

"It is rather elegant, no? This one was practically purring when she perfected the design. It is only by her great generosity that she shares it with the public now." —Pazatha the Impeccable

10-Year Anniversary Golden Wisp Pet

Celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary by dancing in the golden light of this summoned wisp.

Dazzler Dispenser Furnishing

Enliven any area by adding this colorful illusion-making device to it! Spin the handle to send a variety of dazzlers and other effects into the air.

1000 Crowns

Crowns are for use in the Crown Store. The Crown Store can be accessed in game to browse and purchase unique pets, mounts, costumes, and more for your characters in addition to other virtual goods and services.
